months.title: Months
months.description: Trade months as YYYY-MM, e.g. 2026-10. When a month belongs to two crop years (around September), both are returned. Empty = the latest months (see below). In monitoring mode, setting Months limits the check to those months.

latestMonths.title: Latest months
latestMonths.description: When Months is empty and monitoring is off: how many of the most recent months to return. In monitoring mode every listed month is checked instead.

prefectures.title: Prefectures (Japanese)
prefectures.description: Producing prefectures as written by MAFF, e.g. 新潟, 北海道, 秋田. Empty = all.

varieties.title: Variety contains
varieties.description: Words in the variety/brand name, e.g. コシヒカリ, ゆめぴりか, 魚沼. Full-/half-width insensitive.

includeNationalTotal.title: Include national average
includeNationalTotal.description: Add the national average price / total volume row (only when no prefecture or variety filter is set).

onlyNew.title: Monitoring mode (new months and revisions only)
onlyNew.description: Re-read every month MAFF lists and output only new or changed rows since the previous run with the same state key (MAFF corrects preliminary figures, also for earlier months; corrections are returned with changeType = revision). Months / Latest months are ignored unless Months is set.

stateKey.title: State key
stateKey.description: Name of the saved monitoring state. Letters, digits, - and _ only.
